categories.main_business_segments: Sichuan Chuanhuan Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the R&D, design, manufacturing, and sales of rubber and plastic hoses and assemblies for traditional fuel vehicles, new energy vehicles, and motorcycles. The company also develops and supplies cooling pipeline systems for energy storage and data center liquid cooling applications. Its product portfolio includes automotive fuel system hoses, cooling system hoses, brake hoses, turbocharging pipeline assemblies, vacuum brake pipelines, sunroof drainage pipelines, molded pipelines, and motorcycle hoses.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced polymer materials including synthetic rubber and nylon, with proprietary formulations and composite technologies. It employs modular and systematized production aligned with global automotive standards, supported by ERP systems and lean manufacturing for flexible production. The firm has strong R&D capabilities with over 149 patents, including inventions and PCT patents, and operates provincial-level technology centers and laboratories. It emphasizes advanced testing and quality control with CNAS-accredited laboratories and uses innovative materials and processes such as fluorosilicone rubber, EPDM, and carbon nanotube-enhanced compounds.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include over 50 domestic automobile OEMs and more than 50 motorcycle manufacturers, along with over 200 secondary suppliers. Major automotive clients include FAW-Volkswagen, SAIC Volkswagen, BYD, Changan, Geely, Great Wall, GAC, and others, covering both traditional and new energy vehicle sectors. The company also serves data center cooling system providers and energy storage system integrators. Its products are exported to markets including the United States, Vietnam, and Italy.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with its headquarters and manufacturing base in Dazhou, Sichuan Province. Sales are concentrated in Southwest China (41.21% of revenue), East China (31.48%), South China (18.11%), and other domestic regions, with a small portion (2.51%) from overseas markets including the US, EU, and Southeast Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chuanhuan Technology operates as a midstream supplier in the automotive and related industries' supply chain, specializing in the production of rubber and nylon hoses and assemblies that are integrated into vehicle systems by OEMs. It also extends into downstream applications by providing integrated pipeline assemblies and system solutions for new energy vehicles, energy storage, and data center cooling systems.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation aligned with national carbon neutrality goals, focusing on developing environmentally friendly, lightweight, and integrated hose assemblies for new energy vehicles. R&D efforts target advanced materials, low-permeability fuel hoses, liquid cooling systems for energy storage and data centers, hydrogen energy silicone hoses, and high-performance brake hoses. It invests heavily in new product development, process innovation, and expanding into emerging markets such as energy storage, data centers, and military applications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of automotive and motorcycle rubber and plastic hoses and assemblies. The company operates on a make-to-order basis with framework sales contracts, supplying products directly to OEMs and secondary suppliers. It also earns government subsidies related to R&D and manufacturing incentives, but the core revenue is from product sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Chuanhuan Technology is one of the leading domestic suppliers in China's automotive hose market, recognized as a top 10 enterprise in the rubber hose industry for over a decade. It holds a strong market position with extensive OEM partnerships and a broad product portfolio, competing with both domestic and foreign suppliers. The company has a competitive edge in integrated assembly supply and new energy vehicle components, with certifications and quality standards that meet international requirements.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.36 billion, a 22.88% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 202.7 million, up 25.15%. Total assets reached RMB 1.57 billion, growing 15.8% from the prior year. The company maintains a healthy cash flow with operating cash inflows increasing by 34.84%. R&D investment increased to RMB 52.3 million, representing 3.84% of revenue. The company shows a stable growth trajectory with expanding production capacity and market share.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Chuanhuan Technology emphasizes comprehensive lifecycle solutions for automotive hoses, offering a wide variety of products that cover all vehicle systems, earning the nickname 'automotive hose supermarket.' Its competitive advantages include strong R&D capabilities, proprietary material formulations, integrated assembly supply, and compliance with stringent environmental and safety standards such as China VI emission norms and international certifications (CARB, DOT, EPA, UL). The company leads in domestic innovation for liquid cooling systems in energy storage and data centers, enabling import substitution and new market penetration.
